title: Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince
author: J. K. Rowling
summary: As the wizarding world slides toward open war, Harry takes private lessons with the headmaster to learn about the enemy's past. A battered old potions textbook and a suspicion about a rival add to a year of growing up and growing worry.
readIf: you want a book that mixes teenage crushes with a deepening mystery about a villain's origins.
skipIf: you haven't read the earlier books, since this makes sense only as part of the whole.

pairings.reason: The final book, where everything set up here comes to a head.
Another story about a gifted young person at a school of magic, with a more adult, lyrical voice.
A fast, moodier fantasy with a charming rogue and a layered magical world.
